answer_1.quote: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated exceptional capabilities in various text generation tasks
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates essays based on prompts from the ASAP dataset using LLMs, including instruction-based, refined, and continuation writing modes.

answer_2.quote: we report the detection accuracy of both the AI-generated and the human-written essays... we also offer the area under the receiver operating characteristic (AUROC)... Furthermore, we incorporate the AES score as an additional criterion to evaluate the quality of the generated essays.

answer_4.quote: We further conduct human evaluation tests by presenting two annotators (master candidates in computer science) with 162 sets of essay pairs... and recording their pairwise preferences
answer_4.guideline: presenting two annotators... with 162 sets of essay pairs... and recording their pairwise preferences, without disclosing which essays were written by humans or AI
